verdict.rationale: WezTerm's docs list Searchable Scrollback as a built-in feature, with Ctrl-Shift-F to enter search mode and Shift-PageUp/PageDown to navigate. Shell integration also supports jumping back through scrollback to the start of earlier commands. Quick Select adds fast highlighting of pattern matches, and a community user praises the native scrollback. missing for 10: explicit documentation of next/previous match navigation within search mode, independent or hands-on corroboration of how fast or usable search is.
